text:
The median asking rent in the Mettmann district stands at 10.8 €/m², up 6.2 % year‑on‑year and 25.6 % over the last five years, placing the market 22nd among the 37 most expensive German cities. Asking rents are 50 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 7.21 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs 648 € per month.

With a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and 29 days on market, the sector is balanced but tight: 24 % of listings are let within a week and rent‑burden for two residents is 12.5 %. Population growth of 0.9 % over five years adds modest pressure.

The model‑based 12‑month forecast expects median asking rents of 11.31 €/m², ranging from 11.0 to 11.56 €/m², a 4.7 % increase.
